purpose: Independent condition-response evaluation of the encoding-uncertainty reporting rule on a dataset that played no part in the original study.

dataset.cells: primary normal human lung fibroblasts, Lonza CC-2512
dataset.design: 2 oxygen levels (21 percent, 0.5 percent) x 2 treatments (DMSO vehicle, molidustat 10 uM), 4 biological replicates each
dataset.prior_exposure: None. No part of this dataset was inspected during the original study, and no prediction from it had been computed when this plan was written.

inputs.transcripts: 16 RNA-seq libraries, raw counts, converted to counts per million within library. No gene-length normalization and the result is not called TPM. The original GCRMA-derived scale constant is not transferred.
inputs.scale_constant: Refitted as the median of positive reaction evidence over all 16 samples of this dataset, which is the rule the original study used, applied to these data.
inputs.gpr_policy: conservative; an AND with an unmeasured operand leaves the reaction unsupported
inputs.growth_rate: Measured per-condition growth rate mu, per hour, from the compendium. Growth rate is a declared model input, not a predicted target.
inputs.medium: MCDB 131 without glucose, glutamine or phenol red, plus 8 mM glucose, 1 mM L-glutamine and 2 percent dialyzed fetal bovine serum. Dialyzed serum is represented as contributing no free small molecules and only lipoprotein-bound lipids.
inputs.oxygen: The same assumed oxygen capacity is used for both oxygen conditions. Atmospheric percentage is not a measured uptake bound. The primary contrasts are taken within an oxygen level so that this assumption cancels.

uncertainty_set.note: Adding the ordinal encoding expands the uncertainty set and can only make unanimity harder to obtain.

task_measured.rule: biomass reaction fixed at the condition-mean measured growth rate in per hour

task_fraction.rule: biomass reaction fixed at 0.9 times the scenario maximum, the rule used in the original locked study

contrasts.note: Eight declared decisions: four contrasts times two metabolites. All eight are reported whatever the outcome.

measured_eligibility.rule: A contrast is measurement-eligible when the four replicate values of one condition are completely separated from the four of the other, that is min of one group exceeds max of the other.
measured_eligibility.established: from the measured values alone, before any prediction for this dataset existed
measured_eligibility.rationale: This is the analogue of the assay-separability tolerance used in the original study: the measurement must resolve a direction before a prediction can be judged against it.

reporting_rule.units: canonical model units; only the ordering is compared, so no conversion to fmol per cell per hour is attempted
reporting_rule.shared_encoding_interval_support: report a direction only when, for every encoding in the uncertainty set and every cross-replicate profile pair between the two conditions, the lower bound of one exceeds the upper bound of the other by epsilon
reporting_rule.point_unanimity: reported separately and is a weaker criterion than interval support

controls.context_independent_baseline: uniform_pfba under the identical environment and task. If the baseline reproduces a measured condition response as well as the transcript-weighted arms, the response follows from the environment and task assumptions rather than from the transcripts.
controls.task_ablation: comparing task_measured with task_fraction separates the contribution of the measured growth constraint from the contribution of the transcripts.

resampling_unit: biological replicate (experiment 1 to 4). Individual cross-replicate profile pairs are dependent and are never treated as independent samples.
what_this_cannot_establish: It is not a replication of the 44-origin cancer-line ordering estimand.
Four conditions remain four condition contexts, and sixteen libraries are not sixteen independent contexts.
Feasible ranges are numerical model objects, not calibrated confidence intervals.
RNA and metabolite samples are matched by condition, not by dish; the two sets were collected in different years.
No claim of biological accuracy follows from agreement on two metabolites.
stop_rule: If the rate reconstruction or the sample matching proves uninterpretable, the prediction comparison stops and the reason is reported instead of a weaker substitute analysis.
